title: Meet rescued Alaskan wildlife in Portage
description: Follow the loop through the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center and pause at spacious habitats for animals that cannot simply return to the wild. Depending on the day, you may see bison, moose, musk oxen, or other residents while learning why each species matters to Alaska. You can explore much of the center by vehicle and step out for closer views where comfortable.
teaser: Visit a wildlife sanctuary framed by Alaskan mountains.
goodToKnow: Reduced winter schedule; species visibility varies, including winter bear activity.
whyItMightDelightYou: The animals are memorable, but their rescue and conservation stories give the visit its deeper pull.
